reviews.name: Vinod Kannan
reviews.body: We moved to IVY recently and it was the best decision. We were initially unsure as it was a bit expensive.  we love it here. The amenities are  top notch, and people are courteous.  Mu at concierge. Rene at leasing  office and Jeff at maintenance, very  nice people to work  with, overall its a wonderful place to move in.  One con is there is no balcony, but the huge windows makes it up.

response.body:
Hello Vinod,
We're thrilled to hear that you're enjoying your experience at The Ivy. We understand that the decision to move can be a significant one, and we're delighted that you've found it to be worth it. Our team takes great pride in providing top-notch amenities and exceptional service to our residents!

reviews.name: Alina Chornomaz
reviews.body: I am having a great experience so far at The Ivy. Everything is convenient, straightforward and everyone in the staff is very nice and helpful.

response.body:
Hello Alina,
Thank you for your positive feedback! We're delighted to hear that you're having a great experience at The Ivy. Our team strives to make everything as convenient and straightforward as possible, and it’s wonderful to know that you find the staff to be both nice and helpful!

reviews.name: debbie lacasale
reviews.body:
Jeff and John were excellent
The work was completed quickly
They are always so friendly
A pleasure !!

response.body:
Hello Debbie,
Thank you for your feedback! We're thrilled to hear that our team provided excellent service. We truly appreciate your kind words and will be sure to pass them along to the team. We look forward to continuing to help you!

reviews.name: jennifer gonnello
reviews.body: We had some problems with our microwave and a few other items. My husband put in a service request and our super Jeff got back to him immediately and was at our apartment within an hour. He fixed the microwave problem and 2 other problems and even hung a picture for me. I am so happy we moved into the Ivy. Jeff and Jonathan could have not been more helpful and have made the transition here to the Ivy an easy as it could be. Jeff is always pleasant and very approachable. The entire staff here has made us very happy we chose the Ivy. Thank you

response.body:
Hello Jennifer,
Thank you for sharing your experience with us! We're thrilled to hear that our staff were able to address your concerns promptly and effectively. It's wonderful to hear that you're happy with your decision to choose The Ivy as your new home and that our team has contributed to your satisfaction!

reviews.name: John C
reviews.body: The Ivy apartment building has truly exceeded my expectations with its incredible amenities and top-notch amenity spaces. Megan, the property manager, and Ian, the leasing agent, are exceptionally professional and always willing to help. Special thanks to Jeff from maintenance for his swift and efficient work in fixing a few items in my apartment. The staff here make living at The Ivy a truly incredible experience. I love coming home to this community.

response.body:
Hello John,
Thank you so much for your glowing feedback about The Ivy apartment building! We're thrilled to hear that you're enjoying our amenities and the exceptional service provided by our team members, Megan, Ian, and Jeff. We strive to create a welcoming and comfortable living environment for all our residents, and it's fantastic to know that we've succeeded in making your experience truly incredible!

reviews.name: Mey Marani
reviews.body:
Amazing building, great amenities! Quiet, clean, pleasant.
Management and building's super - very attentive and responsive.

response.body:
Hello Mey,
Thank you so much for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you’re enjoying the building and the amenities. Our team takes pride in maintaining a clean, pleasant environment and being as attentive as possible!

reviews.name: Sachsel Gerard
reviews.body:
Have been in my apartment since January 3rd, 2024.  Have had four times that I needed help from maintenance in the last eight and a half months.

Jeff and his staff (John) have been efficient and courteous each time called. It is nice to be able to be out of my apartment and feel comfortable to have Jeff and his crew working in it when I am not present.

We are fortunate to have the present maintenance team at The Ivy.

J. Sachsel  Apt 533

response.body:
Hello Sachsel, 
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your positive feedback. We greatly appreciate your kind words about our maintenance team. It's wonderful to hear that you have been satisfied with their efficiency and courtesy during their visits. Thank you for being a valued resident!

reviews.name: A Gio
reviews.body: Not sure where to start so many positive notes!!!! First my Brother and sister- in -law reside at the IVY and refereed my Mom to do a tour. Me myself have been in the real estate field for over 8 years. So we went Sunday at 2pm  A plus is  they are open 7 days a week. When we arrived at leasing office we both we introduced to Daniel very pleasant person.Told us Chelsie would be our leasing agent taking  us on the tour the place is amazing and Chelsie in all my 8 years was by far the most professional and courteous women i ever encountered she made my mom and i feel like home like family because of her professionalism we signed the application on the spot the amenities are too many to describe and the place is immaculate clean and amazing!!! And if trying to lease ask for Chelsie she showed us everything we asked for very sweet 🫶and patient 👍PROFESSIONAL!!!

response.body:
Hello A Gio,
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your wonderful experience with us! We're thrilled to hear that both you and your mom had such a positive experience at The Ivy. It’s fantastic to know that Chelsie made such a strong impression with her professionalism and courtesy. We’re proud to have her on our team, and it’s clear that her dedication and approach have made a significant difference. Your kind words about the cleanliness and the range of amenities we offer are greatly appreciated. We’ll make sure to pass along your feedback to Chelsie and the rest of the team. Thank you again for your great review and for recommending us. If you or your mom have any further questions or need assistance in the future, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

reviews.name: Matt Ortolani
reviews.body:
I will say this place is very classy still to this day. It has good size apartments, the staff is very friendly, it’s easy to move around the building everything is pretty reliable pretty solid and overall just a great experience.

The gym is definitely one of the better options among many of the apartment buildings in Edgewater. Not super busy, plenty of equipment, different machines different weights easy to get a great workout in without having to leave your building.

Also the view is excellent from the New York City facing apartments and apartment lines, they also have balconies as well and some pretty large apartment configurations that make for a pretty good living set up while also being close to most everything in Edgewater.

Plus all the grocery stores are within 5 to 10 minutes driving you got target, some restaurants, plus entertainment and basic shopping very close by as well. And then you can get into the city within 20 to 40 minutes depending on traffic in your route. Enjoy

reviews.name: Manuela Cristina
reviews.body: I moved in a two bedroom apartment at Riello a month ago, and I absolutely love this place. The property management team is amazing, and the move-in process was flawless. They are very prompt in responding and taking care of our needs. The apartment is very spacious, the view is breathtaking, and the amenities are great.

response.body: We strive to deliver an excellent experience and are glad you found this to be the case. Thanks so much for the kind words!Best,Sean FreemanAssistant Property Manager

reviews.name: Andy Jung
reviews.body: I was here for 2+ years and the best part of the apartment is the staff. Barry, Thalia, Alex and Marino are amazing and extremely helpful people who make this place feel like home. Management did change once since I came here & I would say do your due diligence, but overall, this was a great experience for me.

reviews.name: James
reviews.body:
I moved into the Rolo Apartments when I moved in with my girlfriend in 2019.  It was a sweet place.  We lived in one of the two story apartments right off the lobby with caramel colored floors and a nice chocolate colored door.

The amenities were... there.  The pool had a great view and water.  The gym had heavy things, that was, nice.

Unfortunately we moved out a year ago to buy our own place, but I remember the people being great.  I have always wanted to have a neighbor just like those.

Also the people who worked there were great.  I remember one concierge, Mark, whenever I walked to the desk he knew just what I wanted.  I didn't even have to say anything and he would just go behind the desk and grab my package.  He was really gentle with them, I never had anything get damaged.  He grabbed my package a lot, my girlfriend ordered a lot of things off of Amazon.

TL;DR: great place, and the only reason I moved out was because we found a place to buy.

response.body: Thank you again for taking the time to let us know how we did. We hope you have a great day!-Best, Sean Freeman Assistant Property Manager

reviews.name: avatarfire99245
reviews.body: This building is amazing! Feels like a hotel! The concierge service is what does it for me, They are always so nice and helpful. I know Mark Slater and he is the person that really makes this place feel so inviting and accessible. He has helped in every aspect from packages to parking problems and more. You have to live here if you want the experience of a hotel everyday of your life with amazing and friendly workers.

response.body: Dear Avatarfire99245, We're so glad that we were able to go above and beyond your expectations, we really appreciate your feedback! If you ever need anything else from us, please feel free to give us a call or stop by. Have an awesome day!Elsie PouchieProperty Manager

reviews.name: Venessa Doss
reviews.body: We have enjoyed living at the Riello for almost 4 years. The community is great and the majority of residents are very respectful. The staff is very accommodating and willing to listen to any of your needs, especially Mark Slater. Mark is always available to address any concerns or just have a friendly chat.

response.body: Venessa Doss, thank you so much for your high rating! Thank you, and have a fantastic day!Nicole BlancoSales & marketing AssociateRiello

reviews.name: limor fronimos
reviews.body:
My family and I have lived in the Riello for the past 3 years.  We really enjoy the building, the amenities and great neighbors.  The one employee who always stands out and goes above and beyond is Mark Slater from the front desk.  He is by far the most friendly and helpful concierge, always willing to help out with packages and groceries and whatever else we need.
Another exceptional employee is Sean Freeman from management.  She follows through on any minor or major issues that we have had.

response.body: Thank you so much for providing us with feedback on your experience here! We really appreciate your positive review . Thank you, and have a fantastic day!Best wishesNicole BlancoSales & Marketing Associate

reviews.name: Rosie Noesi
reviews.body: I have lived at the Riello for 10 years now and although there has been some up years and some odd years here....Overall, I love love love my apartment. I have enjoyed my time here and especially love having a doorman! One in particular that stands out is Marc Slater. He is always available and goes above and beyond for anything we need! For beautiful views of the city and lots of closet space I recommend this building !

response.body: Dear Rosie,We strive for 100% satisfaction, and it is great to see you had such a positive experience at Riello. Reviews like this give us motivation and help us ensure we provide high-quality care. We are always more than happy to assist you if anything else comes up. Take care!Warm RegardsElsie PouchieProperty Manager

reviews.body: The leasing team is extremely unresponsive to with communication. We called several times to receive an update on our application that we filled out and now we check the application only to see that the application was cancelled with no explanation as to why. reviews.name: antonio bustamante
reviews.body:
I have had an exceptional experience with The Agnes at 132 Yale Avenue. Maylene, Jameria, and the entire team, including maintenance, cleaning, and concierge, have been incredibly helpful and always maintain a great attitude, fostering a wonderful community atmosphere. Their dedication to ensuring a positive living experience truly sets them apart. Highly recommended!

Francisco.

response.body: Antonio - thanks for the shoutouts to the entire team we loved sharing these kind words with them! We also promise to keep up the hard work and effort to keep The Agnes community strong!

reviews.name: Prince Kumar
reviews.body:
I have been staying here for more than a year I couldn’t be happier with my experience at The Agnes! We just renewed our lease for another term and from  the moment I stepped into the leasing office, Maylene, the leasing manager, made me feel right at home. Her professionalism and genuine care for residents are truly unmatched. She took the time to thoroughly explain all the details, answer my questions, and even went above and beyond to ensure my move-in process was seamless.

The apartment itself is stunning—spacious, modern, and beautifully designed with high-end finishes. The amenities are truly top-notch and make living here feel like a dream. The on-site gym is state-of-the-art, the sparkling pool is perfect for relaxing on sunny days, and the barbecue area is ideal for entertaining friends. The 24-hour are always ready to assist with anything you need.
The community is quiet, well-maintained, and conveniently located near everything. It makes for an easy commute into the city as well as inner NJ.

If you’re looking for an exceptional apartment experience, I highly recommend The Agnes, and be sure to ask for Maylene—you won’t find a better property manager.

response.body: Prince - thank you so much for sharing your kind words about the community overall and Maylene specifically. She is the best and both we and The Agnes community are lucky to have her. We of course agree with your sentiment and really appreciate you being at The Agnes! We hope you continue to have a nice experience, we know Maylene and the team will be there to support you!

reviews.name: Jean-Claude Dowden
reviews.body:
The Agnes is an amazing apartment complex! We’ve been here for 3 years in an amazingly spacious unit (hard to find this kind of sqft).

Thick walls - never any issues hearing neighbors (which is a common complaint in some nearby complexes). Great interior design throughout the common areas and apartments. One of the best amenities would have to be the legitimate in-complex gym with 2 heavy duty power racks and free weights. Not a common thing to see in apartment gyms!

The people here are great as well! Maylene from the management team has always been a big help! The 24/7 concierge, maintenance team, and cleaning team are always very friendly as well! Packages also have a dedicated storage room where concierge ensures deliveries make their way to which is nice (deliveries to lots of apartments tend to just stay out in front of the door where anyone can take them)!

Great place to live!

response.body:
Jean-Claude,
This is fantastic to hear! We are so pleased you have had a lovely experience for 3 years, and we hope you have 3 more! We are so very proud of our staff and love hearing kind words. Thanks again for sharing!

reviews.name: Lacee Harper
reviews.body: The Agnes is a comfortable, nice place to live. Everyone is respectful here and the building has stellar amenities. I would recommend these apartments for anyone who is looking to have a good Jersey City/New York experience. In addition, Dylan has made my experience at The Agnes the best, he is a great Director of Ops and always helpful, dependable, compassionate, respectful and fair about all of the residents here. The Agnes is lucky to have him and will continue to be successful as long as Dylan is there.

response.body: Hi Lacee - thank you so much for the review! We are so pleased to here the kind words - we will be sure Dylan sees this note, we are lucky to have him.  We will make sure to keep working hard to provide the best experience for you and the entire community. Thanks again!

reviews.name: Reginald Larkin
reviews.body: I've lived in Agnes for the last year and this has been my best rental experience. The amenities and well lit apartments are ideal for a metropolitan  professional. The Director of Operations, Maylene Rodriguez has created a warm and inviting atmosphere that anyone would like to call home.

response.body: Thanks Reginald! We appreciate you at The Agnes community and are so proud to hear that Maylene has helped cultivate such a great community for you here!

reviews.name: Elikem Tsikata
reviews.body: My experience at The Agnes has been exceptional. This apartment community boasts an impressive array of amenities, and the property management team truly stands out. The front desk staff consistently go above and beyond to assist residents, and maintenance requests are promptly addressed—usually within a day or two. I wholeheartedly recommend The Agnes to prospective renters!

response.body:
Hi Elikem,
We want to thank you wholeheartedly for the nice review and we are so happy to see the residents at The Agnes enjoy their time on-site. We hope your experience continues to be exceptional, we will work hard to make sure that is the case.

Thanks again!

reviews.name: Destiny Johnson
reviews.body: My fiancé and I have lived at The Agnes since the very opening of it in 2021. I’ve lived in a couple apartments before then but hands down best experience I’ve had living in apartment. From the front desk reception to the leasing office, to the maintenance and amenities, it’s been truly lovely. It’s also a great place as a community, everyone is super friendly and the Agnes holds resident events and residents actually attend and mingle and it really feels like home! The apartments themselves were great, we lived in a one bedroom then transferred to a 2 bedroom for more space and the transfer process was very smooth! If it weren’t for having to relocate out of state we would’ve stayed at the Agnes even longer! A special shout out to Maylene in leasing and Frank the super, and every single one of the front desk staff who are always friendly! If you are looking for a place to live on the West Side of Jersey City I couldn’t recommend that Agnes enough!

response.body: Hi Destiny - thank you for the 5-star review and kind words! The team has worked hard to build a strong community at The Agnes since its inception and it's fabulous to see the hard work pay off! If you ever have any other questions - you know you can always reach out. Thanks again for choosing to make The Agnes your home!

reviews.name: Mirko Dragas
reviews.body:
Living at The Agnes has truly been a game-changer for me. I moved in on the fifth floor and from day one, I knew this place was special. The property manager, Maylene , has been nothing short of incredible.

She’s always so accommodating and patient, no matter what I need, and the rest of the staff are just as friendly and helpful. It's like they've all made it their mission to ensure everyone here feels at home.

What really blows me away is how peaceful it is. It’s hard to find a spot that’s so calm, yet so perfectly located. Nestled between the Holland Tunnel and I-95, it's super convenient for me whether I need to get to the city or drive-by through Jersey. But despite being in such a prime spot, it feels like a little oasis.

And then there are the amenities... where do I even start? The gym is top-notch, the pool is a dream, and having a 24-hour concierge just adds to the comfort. The barbecue area is perfect for summer hangouts, and the game room is a fun spot to unwind. There are honestly so many little perks that make living here feel like a luxury.

Maylene and the team make everything feel easy, and I’ve never felt so settled and content in a place. I’m just so glad I get to call  The Agnes home.

response.body: Thanks Mirko! I will share the kind words with Maylene and the whole team! Thanks again for choosing the Agnes, we are lucky to have you in our community and we hope you enjoy the rest of your time here!
